dialogues.speaker: Reetta
dialogues.text: Well... Regular followers like me need to pass exams for hymns and bles{RUBY#[D]kuuvahki}sings before we can become an "acolyte."

dialogues.speaker: Reetta
dialogues.text: Then, if I could show myself as devout and reliable as Ehrnrooth or Vernadska, I might one day rise to the rank of "priestess"...

dialogues.speaker: Reetta
dialogues.text: But that would require me to take on greater responsibilities, so I'm better off staying as I am now... I think.
